brief_summary: This Phase 1 study will assess the mass balance recover of carbon-14 (14C) labelled ETC-1002 and the routes and rates of excretion of \[14C\]-ETC-1002
brief_title: Single Radiolabeled Dose Study to Investigate the Absorption, Metabolism and Excretion of [14C]-ETC-1002

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy Male Volunteers
* BMI 10-35 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hx of CV, renal, hepatic, chronic respiratory or GI disease
* Hx of drug or alcohol abuse
* smoking within 12 mos of screening

official_title: A Phase 1, Open-Label,Single Radiolabeled Dose Study to Investigate the Absorption, Metabolism and Excretion of [14C]-ETC-1002 in Healthy Male Volunteers

primary_outcomes.measure: Level of [14C]-ETC-1002 in urine and feces after a single dose
